baseline: A1 preregistered paired reference; A2 independent full100 process, fluctuation only

definitions.GT: stride8 center+4; half-open correct target cell; existing visible projection; child own source
definitions.recall: fixed evaluable source grid, any target parent yields valid child EPE<2; each source once

native.selection: native flattened global torch.topk K=min(6000,N0,N1), then strictly P>max(P)*0.1; original order/ties retained

neighborhood.C_tie: prefer B target, then P descending and targetID
neighborhood.affine: R4 same anchors; centered and scale normalized; full rank, cond<=100, finite, median residual<=2; exactly3 separate
neighborhood.anchors: protected native row-and-column rank1; distinct source; exclude query source; nearest source Euclidean coarse-grid radius, distance then sourceID then targetID
neighborhood.translation: coordinatewise median displacement; median Euclidean residual<=2

quota.allocator: largest feasible r<=q; protect first M-r; r distinct low source grids not covered by protected entries; positive finite top5 nonempty; sources by row maximum P descending then original source ID
quota.pool: top5 positive finite P targets among unchanged native candidates, no column rank restriction
quota.score_B: 2/(row_rank+column_rank), ranks in full P; score ties P descending then target raw grid ID

tolerance.directional_shift: abs(scene difference)>0.001 in same direction for >=ceil(2/3 common scenes); structural errors not tolerated
